Commentary.Commentary: Right then that's it from this contest, The next game of this tri-series is set to be played between Sri Lanka Women and South Africa Women on 9th may at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT, previous day). You can join us an hour early for the pre-match build-up and updates. Until then, take care, and cheers!

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that this game was very important and they wantd to end on a positive note. Adds that the pitch was good and their bowling unit performed well. Adds that Deepti was really good with the bat and ball and she has been a key player for them. Ends by saying that she was happy to see Amanjot Kaur picking wickets as well.

Jemimah Rodrigues is the Player of the Match for her century. She says that she is happy with the performance and their main target is the world cup. Adds that thye lost early wickets but they build partnerships well. Says that Deepti was excellent with the bat as well. Ends by saying that she has been more calm now and playing different leagues have helped her a lot.

Chloe Tryon, the skipper of South Africa Women, says that they were not that good with the ball. Adds that they fell 20-30 runs short. She says that they should have put pressure on the India Women batters early on. Adds that they need to improve with the ball. ends by saying that they will look to try out different things and they will look to come back stronger and prepare well for the world cup.
Presentations coming up...

Earlier in the game, India women batting first posted a gigantic total of 337 ob board. Thanks to a couple of brilliant knocks from the centurion Jemimah and Deepti who missed out on her ton by 7 runs. India lost a couple early on and they were 3 down for just 50 on board. Jemimah along with Smriti first and than that marthon partnership with Deepti managed to help the side post 337. Klaas, Nadine and Mlaba took a couple each while Tryon and Annerie took one apiece.

India's bowlers delivered a sensational performance, with Amanjot being particularly lethal, claiming 3 wickets. Deepti Sharma picked two while Shree Charani and Rawal also chipped in with 1 wicket each. They were excellent with their fielding as well.

Chasing down a mammoth total, South Africa Women were never off the hook. The side lost Godall in the second over and were on the backfoot ever since. Britz, Smit, Shangase and Jafta did get starts but departed when the time was to step on the accelerator. Dercksen was the only one alongside Tryon who matched fire with fire but even their efforts were not enough to make a game out of this contest.

India Women have secured a spot in the Tri-series final alongside Sri Lanka after winning this match by 23 runs. In the second innings, South Africa Women struggled to chase down the massive total of 337, losing key wickets early on, including Goodall in the second over. They saw some hope towards the end but ultimately fell short.
That;s it! Flatter, on off, Sune Luus knocks it down the ground for one. India Women beat South Africa Women by 23 runs!
